headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”，分析称债市调整多出于止盈需求
headlines.summary: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”。8月11日，央行未开展7天期逆回购操作，当日有465亿元逆回购到期，公开市场实现净回笼465亿元。8月11日，资金面总体平稳，债市则在前期连续走强后震荡回调。受访人士认为，此次逆回购“零操作”主要缘于月初流动性充裕、金融机构融资需求下降。债市调整更多来自收益率快速下行后的止盈需求。随着税期临近、政府债券发行提速，加之超长债交易趋于拥挤，债券市场短期内仍将有所波动。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC reverse repo shows zero operations again; analysts say bond market adjustment is largely driven by profit-taking demand
headlines.summary_en: PBOC reverse repo shows 'zero operation' again. On August 11, the central bank conducted no 7-day reverse repo operations, with 46.5 billion yuan in reverse repos maturing that day, resulting in a net withdrawal of 46.5 billion yuan from the open market. On August 11, liquidity conditions were broadly stable, while the bond market pulled back after recent consecutive gains. Sources say the zero reverse repo operation mainly reflects ample liquidity at the start of the month and reduced financing demand from financial institutions. The bond market adjustment is more driven by profit-taking after rapid yield declines. With the tax period approaching, accelerated government bond issuance, and increasingly crowded ultra-long bond trading, the bond market will remain volatile in the short term. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 西太平洋银行：进一步加息并不是澳洲联储的基准情景
headlines.summary: 西太平洋银行首席经济学家Luci Ellis认为，澳洲联储进一步加息并不是基准情景。澳洲联储周二将官方利率维持在4.35%不变，但其政策沟通中充斥着对通胀传导风险以及潜在外部冲击的鹰派警告。不过，曾担任澳洲联储高级经理的Ellis指出，央行自身的经济预测显示，通胀将以缓慢但持续的路径回落至目标水平。她表示：“这并不是一种支持进一步提高利率的预测轨迹。”

headlines.title_en: Westpac: Further rate hikes are not the RBA's base case scenario
headlines.summary_en: Westpac Chief Economist Luci Ellis says further rate hikes by the RBA are not the base case. The RBA held its official rate at 4.35% on Tuesday, but its communication was full of hawkish warnings about inflation pass-through risks and potential external shocks. However, Ellis, a former senior RBA manager, points out that the central bank's own forecasts show inflation returning to target on a slow but steady path. She says: 'This is not a forecast trajectory that supports further rate increases.'

headlines.title: 下半年A股投资图谱浮现：科技为矛、改善为盾，两大核心主线成机构共识
headlines.summary: 进入下半年，A股市场在震荡磨底中加快寻找新的运行主线。多方调研获悉，多家一线机构已形成明确共识：机构资金可依托基本面研究适度左侧布局，普通投资者在右侧信号出现时可进一步提高风险偏好；在配置方向上，应由单一赛道抱团转向科技成长、基本面改善与高股息资产的均衡组合。AI产业趋势延续、政策支持持续加码以及资本市场双向开放提速，将为下半年结构性行情提供支撑，但海外货币政策、地缘局势等不确定因素仍需警惕。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: H2 A-share investment map emerges: technology as spearhead, improvement as shield; two core mainlines become institutional consensus
headlines.summary_en: Entering the second half of the year, the A-share market is accelerating its search for a new main trading theme amid a bottoming process. Multi-channel research indicates that several leading institutions have formed a clear consensus: institutional funds can rely on fundamental research for moderate left-side positioning, while ordinary investors can raise risk appetite when right-side signals appear; in terms of allocation, the approach should shift from crowding into a single track to a balanced portfolio of tech growth, fundamental improvements, and high-dividend assets. The continuation of AI industry trends, sustained policy support, and accelerated two-way opening of capital markets will underpin structural opportunities in the second half, but uncertainties such as overseas monetary policy and geopolitical situations still warrant caution. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 大行评级｜花旗：下调万洲国际目标价至10.1港元，维持“买入”评级
headlines.summary: 花旗发表报告指，万洲国际附属史密斯菲尔德第二季营运表现符合该行对万洲国际美国及墨西哥地区的预期，但其将2026年经调整经营溢利指引下调7%则逊于预期。花旗认为，史密斯菲尔德下调指引是由于生猪期货价格呈下跌趋势。跌势很可能源于行业供应增加以及通胀削弱需求。然而，由于第四季生猪价格通常季节性偏弱，目前判断美国生猪价格周期是否逆转仍为时尚早。该行将万洲国际2026-2028年预期盈利下调6-11%，以反映对美国及中国业务的较低估计，目标价由12.3港元下调至10.1港元；假设股息维持不变，并基于具吸引力的收益率维持“买入”评级。

headlines.title_en: Citi Research | Citi cuts WH Group target price to HK$10.1, maintains 'Buy' rating
headlines.summary_en: Citi report says WH Group subsidiary Smithfield's Q2 operating performance was in line with Citi's expectations for WH Group's US and Mexico regions, but its 7% cut to 2026 adjusted operating profit guidance missed expectations. Citi believes Smithfield's guidance cut is due to declining hog futures prices, likely stemming from increased industry supply and inflation-weakened demand. However, since Q4 hog prices are typically seasonally weak, it is too early to judge whether the US hog price cycle has reversed. Citi cut WH Group 2026-2028 earnings estimates by 6-11% to reflect lower estimates for US and China operations, with target price cut from HK$12.3 to HK$10.1; maintaining 'Buy' rating on attractive yield assuming unchanged dividends.
